🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 active：is_high_vol > 0
  2. 计算 prior_active：active.shift(1)
  3. 计算 transition：(active & ~prior_active).astype(float)
  4. 计算 close_return：close.pct_change()
  5. 计算 transition_return：transition * close_return
  6. 计算 event_count：transition.滚动窗口(30, min_periods=30).sum()
  7. 计算 carried_return：transition_return.滚动窗口(30, min_periods=30).sum()
  8. 计算 factor：carried_return / (1.0 + event_count)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_volume_state_transition_carry_smooth(df): """Smoothed carry of price movement following transitions into unusually active volume.""" df_copy = df.copy() is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20) active = is_high_vol > 0 prior_active = active.shift(1).fillna("kw">class="kw">False) transition = (active & ~prior_active).astype(float) close_return = df_copy["close"].pct_change() transition_return = transition * close_return event_count = transition.rolling(30, min_periods=30).sum() carried_return = transition_return.rolling(30, min_periods=30).sum() factor = carried_return / (1.0 + event_count) df_copy["factor_volume_state_transition_carry_smooth"] = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_volume_state_transition_carry_smooth"]
